description: The bar chart illustrates the count of different reasoning types across two language models, GPT3.5 and Mistral 7B, as evaluated in the context of self-contradictory reasoning. The x-axis, labeled “Model,” categorizes the data into two discrete groups: “GPT3.5” and “Mistral 7B.” The y-axis, labeled “Count,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100 with major tick marks at intervals of 20. Five reasoning types are represented by colored bars: Type1 (teal), Type2 (orange), Type3 (blue), RR (magenta), and WW (green), as indicated in the legend. For GPT3.5, Type1 has a count of approximately 15, Type2 around 25, Type3 is near 0 (not visible), RR is approximately 110, and WW is about 35. For Mistral 7B, Type1 is approximately 28, Type2 around 25, Type3 is again near 0, RR is approximately 110, and WW is about 30. The RR category dominates in both models, while Type3 shows no visible presence in either.
